title: Party Finder
description: A regional event discovery platform for the Rhön Grabfeld area, built as a foundational web development project. Features a clean, responsive interface with integrated Google Maps functionality and event listings to help users discover local parties and gatherings.
features: Responsive web design
Google Maps integration
Event listings with location and date information
Social media integration
Contact form functionality
Regional focus on Rhön Grabfeld area

title: Responsive Navigation Bar
description: A modern, fully responsive navigation component built with pure CSS, focusing on flexbox layout principles and mobile-first design. Features a collapsible hamburger menu, dropdown functionality, and smooth responsive transitions across all device sizes.
features: Mobile-first responsive design
Hamburger menu with smooth animations
Dropdown navigation with hover effects
CSS-only interactive elements (no JavaScript)
Flexible layout using CSS Flexbox
Cross-browser compatible styling
Custom CSS variables for theme consistency

title: Portfolio Template
description: A comprehensive portfolio website template featuring modern design principles, advanced CSS Grid layouts, and responsive breakpoints. Built as a learning project to understand full-scale website architecture, component-based design, and professional web presentation standards.
features: Multi-section layout with smooth scroll navigation
Advanced CSS Grid implementation for complex layouts
Professional card-based service presentation
Responsive hamburger navigation system
Custom CSS variables for consistent theming
Mobile-first responsive design approach
Social media integration layout
Professional typography and spacing systems

title: Interactive Card Website
description: An immersive card-based website featuring advanced CSS animations, video backgrounds, and interactive hover effects. Built to explore CSS pseudo-classes, keyframe animations, and modern visual effects including animated RGB borders and smooth transform transitions.
features: Full-screen video background with responsive scaling
Interactive card hover animations with smooth transitions
Animated RGB border effects using CSS keyframes
Progressive content reveal on hover interaction
Custom gradient overlays and blur effects
Responsive design with mobile-optimized interactions
Advanced CSS pseudo-element animations

title: Vokabeltrainer (C++ / Qt)
description: An interactive vocabulary trainer in C++ with Qt, enabling local learning between German ↔ English. The application supports import/export of vocabulary, different training modes (with or without time limits), and persistent learning algorithms based on the flashcard system. With a modern frameless interface, modular MVC design, and secure configuration management, the project provides a professional offline and cloud-synced learning platform.
features: Interactive German ↔ English vocabulary training
Offline usage with locally stored vocabulary
Import/export of vocabulary via TXT and Google Drive integration
Different training modes with optional time limit
Frameless, modern window design with drag & drop navigation
Stacked widget system for seamless section changes
Persistent learning algorithms based on flashcard system
Flexible vocabulary management with unit and folder structure
Progress tracking and visual feedback
Secure configuration and credential management
Automated build and deployment system for Windows

title: Webserver Playground
description: A comprehensive full-stack project with Docker-based infrastructure that unites multiple web applications in a modular environment. The playground includes a PHP/Apache backend with a MySQL database, JWT-based authentication, and a custom-built CSS framework. In addition to classic CRUD systems, interactive applications such as a 3D Rubik’s Cube, Snake Game, and a Speed-Dating Generator were implemented. The project demonstrates modern web development with security concepts, containerization, and responsive design.
features: Docker-based multi-container infrastructure with Apache, MySQL, and phpMyAdmin
JWT authentication with role and session management
Security features: prepared statements, password hashing, input validation
Custom-built CSS framework 'Mestrap' using Flexbox/Grid
Speed-Dating Generator with Excel/CSV upload and dynamic pairing
Interactive 3D Rubik’s Cube simulator with CSS3 transforms
Canvas-based Snake Game with highscore system
RSS Reader with external feeds, CRUD operations, and grid/list view
HTML tags reference with interactive code examples
Admin panel with full CRUD system and user management
CRUD log system with form validation and error handling
Responsive design with media queries and custom properties
Relational MySQL database with normalized tables and referential integrity
DevOps features: Docker Compose, volume mapping, network isolation, environment configuration
Modular architecture with structured code organization

title: Real-Time Tournament Platform
description: A full-stack multiplayer tournament platform with real-time communication for up to 16 players. The system combines a responsive Vanilla JavaScript frontend with a Node.js/Express.js backend and a SQLite database. Using WebSockets, it provides high-performance live synchronization between all clients, including a lobby system, real-time scoring, and automatic tournament logic. With its modular structure, secure authentication, and event-driven architecture, the project demonstrates comprehensive full-stack development skills.
features: Real-time communication via WebSockets
Tournament bracket system with automatic round scheduling
Live synchronization and player tracking (lobby system)
Dynamic player pairing and progress display
Admin interface with live monitoring
Token-based authentication and session management
RESTful API for CRUD operations
Responsive UI using Grid/Flexbox
Audio/Video integration for immersive gameplay
Anti-cheat mechanisms and input validation
Scalable, event-driven architecture

title: Vokabeltrainer REST API
description: A fully self-developed REST API backend for an interactive vocabulary trainer. The project demonstrates a deep understanding of PHP fundamentals and object-oriented architecture without relying on any frameworks. With a modular service layer, JWT authentication, relational database design, and an intelligent recommendation system, the project showcases professional full-stack development skills and modern API design.
features: User management with roles (Admin, Teacher, Pupil)
JWT authentication with token validation
Creation and management of vocabulary units
Intelligent recommendation system with personalized learning paths
Multiple test types and progress tracking
Social features: classroom, messaging system, friends lists
SQL injection protection using prepared statements
Comprehensive OpenAPI documentation (3000+ lines)
Custom routing engine without a framework
Service-layer architecture for loose coupling
Multilingual architecture and flexible database abstraction
Unit and API endpoint tests using PHPUnit

title: MESIFY - Spotify Clone with YouTube Integration
description: A full-featured Spotify alternative as a React Native mobile app that uses YouTube as the audio source. The project combines complex web scraping, Firebase integration, and modern mobile development. With a powerful audio player, personalized playlists, and cross-platform synchronization, MESIFY demonstrates deep understanding of mobile development, API integration, and media processing.
features: Full-featured audio player with shuffle, repeat, and queue management
Background playback using react-native-track-player
Web scraping for YouTube audio without official API
Spotify API integration for playlists and metadata
User accounts with Firebase Authentication
Liked songs system with cloud synchronization
Offline usage with AsyncStorage
Custom playlists with CRUD operations
APK auto-update system for Android
Gradient UI with Spotify-like design
Debounced search with dual system (YouTube + Google fallback)
Cross-platform deployment (iOS & Android)

title: Peer-to-Peer Network Application (sshdir)
description: A Java-based peer-to-peer application with a client-server architecture that enables remote file access and file transfer. The project was developed without external frameworks to deepen understanding of Java fundamentals such as socket programming, multi-threading, and clean code architecture.
features: TCP socket connections with multi-client support
Bidirectional communication using a custom protocol
Remote file browser with directory navigation
Asynchronous file download and streaming file transfer
Cross-platform path normalization (Windows/Linux/macOS)
Command-line interface with ANSI colors
Interactive help system with live status messages
Thread-pool management using Executors.newCachedThreadPool
Robust error handling and resource management
Zero-dependency approach (only Java Standard Library)

title: HTTP Webserver Following RFC Standards
description: A Java webserver developed from scratch, fully compliant with RFC-7230 through RFC-7235. The project implements HTTP/1.1 according to standards, supports multiple methods and status codes, features a dynamic routing system, and provides secure JWT-based authentication. The architecture is based on multithreading, the MVC pattern, and clean abstraction for database access.
features: RFC-7230 to RFC-7235 compliant HTTP/1.1 implementation
Multithreaded server with connection-per-thread architecture
Thread-pool management for scalability
Support for GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD methods
Full RFC-compliant status code handling
JWT-based authentication with roles and expiration
Prepared statements and input validation to prevent SQL injection
MySQL integration with typed parameter binding
Reflection-based dynamic routing with JSON configuration
RESTful API design with versioning (/api/v1/)
Configurable system with JSON-based settings
Robust error handling with custom exceptions
Structured logging using SLF4J
Unit testing with JUnit 5 and Mockito

title: REST API Vocabulary Trainer (Spring Boot Migration)
description: A vocabulary trainer migrated from PHP to Java Spring Boot with modern microservice architecture, test-driven development, and enterprise-grade security. The project implements user management, vocabulary handling, multilingual support, and secure JWT-based authentication. Using Spring Boot 3.2.5, Spring Security 6, and JPA/Hibernate, a scalable, maintainable, and production-ready system was built.
features: User registration & login with JWT-based authentication
Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions
Hierarchical vocabulary organization (Units → Collections → Dictionaries)
Difficulty levels according to CEFR (A1–C2)
Multilingual support via language entities
RESTful API with versioned endpoints (/v1/)
Spring Security integration with custom authentication filter
BCrypt password encryption
Comprehensive input validation (Bean Validation, DTOs)
Custom exception handling with structured error responses
Progress tracking for learning statistics
SSL/HTTPS support and CORS integration
Layered architecture (Controller, Service, Repository, Entity)
JUnit 5 + MockMvc tests (TDD approach, high test coverage)
Logging system with configurable log levels
Docker-ready & CI/CD capable

title: WHIZ – Multiplayer Party Quiz App
description: An innovative React Native cross-platform app for multiplayer party games with serverless peer-to-peer networking. Up to 16 players can play quiz and mini-games in real-time. The project combines modern UI/UX, real-time synchronization, gamification mechanics, and a modular, scalable architecture.
features: Serverless P2P multiplayer architecture using TCP sockets
Real-time synchronization for up to 16 players
Automatic lobby management (join/leave, codes, IP discovery)
Four question types: multiple choice, estimation, creative answers, challenges
Multiple game modes (Classic Chaos, Survival, Drunk & Disorderly, Custom Collections)
Gamification system with ranking, achievements, levels, and statistics
Custom design system with dark/light mode and Lottie animations
Multilingual support (German/English, RTL-ready)
Persistent storage using AsyncStorage
Push notifications and deep linking
Error tracking with Sentry
Testing with Jest and TypeScript strict mode

title: MindMesh – Connected Knowledge
description: MindMesh is a full-stack application for connected knowledge management with AI integration. The platform combines a Django backend, React Native frontend, and Google Generative AI to provide users with personalized learning experiences, intelligent quizzes, and a connected knowledge system.
features: Thread and tag system for knowledge organization
AI-powered content analysis and quiz generation
Personalized recommendations based on user preferences
Hierarchical comments and upvote system
Adaptive scoring and progress tracking
Multilingual support with i18n-js
OAuth2 Google Sign-In and JWT authentication
Cross-platform app (iOS, Android, Web) with React Native
Clean backend architecture with Django Ninja
End-to-end testing with Maestro and unit tests with Pytest/Jest

title: Die Macher – Industry 4.0 Cyber-Physical System
description: “Die Macher” is a cyber-physical Industry 4.0 system featuring a complete pick-and-place setup, color recognition, and real-time data processing. It combines Raspberry Pi sensors, Java Spring Boot for robot control and data coordination, dockerized microservices with InfluxDB/MQTT/Node-RED, and a modern Next.js frontend for live dashboards.
features: Pick-and-place system with Dobot robot and color recognition
Real-time sensor monitoring (temperature, humidity, color)
Energy consumption and cost calculation per component (awattar API)
OPC UA-secured communication between Raspberry Pi and Java backend
MQTT-based real-time data distribution (EMQX broker)
InfluxDB for time-series data & PostgreSQL for relational data
Node-RED for workflow automation
Next.js frontend with live dashboards and Recharts visualizations
TLS-encrypted communication using X.509 certificates
Dockerized multi-system architecture with CI/CD pipeline
Custom TCP protocol for Dobot control
Event-driven & asynchronous data processing
Monitoring with health checks and structured logging

title: MotoSync – Connected Car Plattform
description: MotoSync is a modern connected-car platform similar to BMW ConnectedDrive, connecting vehicles via OBD2 to a cloud-based IoT infrastructure. The system enables real-time vehicle telemetry, remote monitoring, and control through a mobile app. It combines a scalable Spring Boot microservice architecture, secure MQTT communication, and a modern React Native frontend.
features: OBD2 integration for vehicle diagnostics and telemetry
Real-time MQTT communication between vehicle and cloud
Telemetry processing: speed, engine temperature, fuel level, RPM
Device pairing system with serial numbers and pairing passwords
Cross-platform mobile app (iOS/Android) with React Native
OAuth2 authentication and biometric login
Real-time dashboard for vehicle data
AES-encrypted data transmission
Microservices with Spring Boot and API gateway
File server with MinIO storage
InfluxDB for telemetry time series
PostgreSQL for user data
Redis for caching and sessions
Docker containerization with Compose
Prometheus monitoring
Security features: rate limiting, device authentication, JWT, MQTT validation

title: LGTM Monitoring Stack – Kubernetes Observability
description: Implementation of a complete LGTM (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir) monitoring stack for Kubernetes environments, focusing on centralized log aggregation, visualization, and security. The project provides a production-ready, scalable solution with Kustomize and Helm charts for efficient DevOps monitoring.
features: Centralized log aggregation for Kubernetes workloads
Real-time log streaming with structured metadata
Multi-tenant architecture with retention policies
Distributed Loki with TSDB schema v13 and Snappy compression
Grafana dashboards with security-hardened configuration
Alloy agent & gateway mode for telemetry collection
S3-compatible object storage via MinIO with KES encryption
GitOps-ready deployment with Kustomize
Helm chart management for LGTM components
Security-by-design: non-root execution, read-only FS, secret management
TLS/Cert-Manager integration for encrypted communication
Alerting & monitoring via Grafana Alert Manager
